verifiedLocalBehavior: The generic website normalizer has one additive CommonJS smokeBoundedText export so the generator can compose the existing helper declaration. No normalizer function body changed; the earlier Cloud runtime file hash remains historical.
Registry is looked up and bound before authenticated provider read descriptors can be emitted; callback-supplied account/status/cost/context is discarded.
A processed registered run returns its complete saved SQL receipt with updated:false and finished_now:false before provider reads or repeat persistence.
Terminal samples require the registered original run and approved actor, actual authenticated usage amount, terminal wire status, dataset binding and real ISO date. TIMED-OUT maps to SQL TIMED_OUT.

Native callback source uses two authenticated GETs separated by a ten-second Wait and rejects unstable identity/cost. The pure planner separately bounds changing-cost samples to four total observations within 180 seconds.

Exact-page groups permit one successful normalized item or an empty failed-terminal group; unsupported URL/hash/field changes, overflow, malformed Unicode and JSONB-incompatible NUL text fail before a persistence descriptor.

The generated success dataset path has a throwing live-release gate. The source-only continuation uses supported top-level fields url,markdown,metadata,crawl,error and accepts exactly one row from a request limited to two.
Applied atomic SQL remains the single ingest/report/stable-cost/completion/parent-finish transaction. The new graph does not split those writes or issue another finish_run call.

Missing or malformed native SQL receipts always proceed to registry/pending readback after raw errors are discarded. A committed saved result without a native acknowledgement suppresses dispatch; an unprocessed readback stops for manual same-argument reconciliation.

Observed native receipts must match the complete durable saved receipt, including SQL JSONB digest, item IDs, totals and six-decimal rounded cost. No client JSON.stringify digest is substituted for PostgreSQL JSONB canonical text.
Saved-only reconciliation is authoritative for original-run completion but reports payloadEqualityVerified:false; it does not claim that the attempted groups produced that receipt.
Registration reconciliation uses the same original returned actor-run ID and known parent/account context. A missing original ID after ambiguous launch is blocked without a replacement actor POST.
WF99 source is recovery-only and contains no actor POST or start_run. Missing workflow/tag references fail generation; local tests use explicitly synthetic references.

independentReview.scope: Selected shared registry, settlement, decimal rounding, receipt, proof-boundary and original-registration paths; no live checks
